title: NullPointerException
description: The program crashes when accessing a property of an object that has not been initialized.
root_cause: The object reference is null when the program tries to access one of its fields or methods.
solution: Initialize the object before accessing its properties. Alternatively, check whether the reference is null.

title: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
description: The program tries to access an array element using an index outside the valid range.
root_cause: The index is negative or greater than or equal to the array length.
solution: Check that the index is between zero and array length minus one before accessing the array.

title: IndexError: List Index Out of Range
description: A Python program attempts to retrieve an element from a list using an invalid index.
root_cause: The list is shorter than expected or the program calculates an invalid index.
solution: Check the list length and validate the index before accessing the element.

title: Segmentation Fault
description: A C program crashes because it accesses memory that it is not permitted to access.
root_cause: Possible causes include dereferencing an invalid pointer, accessing memory after it has been freed, or accessing memory outside an array.
solution: Check pointer validity, ensure allocated memory is used correctly, and validate array boundaries.

title: SyntaxError
description: Python cannot parse a statement because the code violates its syntax rules.
root_cause: Possible causes include missing colons, unmatched parentheses, or incorrectly structured statements.
solution: Inspect the reported line and correct the syntax according to Python rules.

title: TypeError: Unsupported Operand
description: A Python operation fails because its operands have incompatible types.
root_cause: The program attempts an operation that is not supported for the supplied data types.
solution: Check the types of the operands and convert them when appropriate.

title: NumberFormatException
description: Java cannot convert a string into the requested numeric format.
root_cause: The input string contains characters or formatting that cannot be parsed as a number.
solution: Validate the input before parsing it and handle NumberFormatException when necessary.

title: KeyError
description: A Python dictionary lookup fails because the requested key does not exist.
root_cause: The program accesses a dictionary using a key that is absent from the dictionary.
solution: Check whether the key exists or use the dictionary get method when an optional value is acceptable.

title: IndexOutOfBoundsException
description: A Java list operation fails because the requested index is outside the list's valid range.
root_cause: The index is negative or is greater than or equal to the list size.
solution: Check the list size and ensure the requested index is valid.

title: Null Pointer Access in C++
description: A C++ program attempts to access an object through a null pointer.
root_cause: The pointer does not refer to a valid object when the program dereferences it.
solution: Initialize the pointer appropriately and verify that it refers to a valid object before dereferencing it.
